scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.includes('pnpm')){console.error('This repo uses pnpm. Please run: pnpm install'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter soma run typecheck && pnpm --filter tapia run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter soma run lint && pnpm --filter tapia run lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter soma run format && pnpm --filter tapia run format
